entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Mexica people built Tenochtitlan on a lake island — a city of 200,000 with floating gardens, aqueducts, and causeways. The Triple Alliance conquered an empire of 5–6 million. Their warrior culture, sun worship, and human sacrifice defined their era.
